title: Polyhedral hyperbola asymptotics when the maximal-sum face is not contained in any coordinate hyperplane
author: Marta Pieropan; Damaris Schindler
difficulty_reason: The usual one-constraint hyperbola identity does not count boxes in a general polytope or control small-coordinate regions under box PropertyI alone. The authors prove volume and coordinate-projection bounds near the maximizing face, approximate weighted slice counts by lattice counting and separate dyadic interior and boundary contributions. This new polyhedral decomposition yields both the exact leading constant and the logarithmic saving without the stronger lower-dimensional-box assumption, beyond merely applying Davenport's lemma.

The original asymptotic constant, factorial and stated loglog error power are preserved. Read all new polytope slice/projection constructions9–15, auxiliary geometric sums6–9 and consecutive hyperbola proof16–28 through the explicit completion of Theorem1.1. Davenport lattice counting and Faulhaber finite differences are named prior foundations. No PropertyII or fixed-variable sum hypothesis is added. No separate toric Campana application or lower-dimensional-face parameter variant counted. PDF authors Marta Pieropan and Damaris Schindler, volume11/year2024/DOI251 and explicitCCBY4 verified.
